protocol: Official April 8-21 train and April 22-28 validation split; April 8-18 to April 19-21 temporal screening for multi-view candidates; no hidden-test outcomes; four user-ID-modulo folds for residual selection. All neighbor support, outcomes, priors, and similarities come only from the training block.

experiments.name: multi-view user-neighbor collaborative filtering
experiments.evidence: April 8-18 to April 19-21 screening selected signed and TF-IDF exposure profiles over item, author, music, tag-set, and type targets. The strongest validation standalone candidate reached 0.58122635 after within-user ranking. None improved the retained champion stably: the best apparent OOF result was 0.61280525, but its fixed score was 0.61280108 and one held-out fold regressed.

experiments.name: support-aware and uncertainty-penalized neighbor ranking
experiments.evidence: The accepted neighbor graph has nonzero support for 75.16% of validation rows, but median weighted support is only 0.1632. A 55-candidate scan covered empirical-Bayes smoothing, support shrinkage, hard support gates, and beta-posterior lower-confidence bounds. The best fixed residual reached 0.61280525, only +0.00000060, with a negative fold; the best fixed replacement scored 0.61280417. Neither met the stable-gain rule.

successful_tracked_run_totals.note: An earlier multi-view prototype run failed after candidate construction because of a result-name parser bug; its incomplete tracker record is excluded from these totals.

conclusion: Multi-view similarity and support-aware uncertainty corrections did not provide a stable gain beyond 0.6128046513. The accepted smoothing-8, squared-similarity, 60-neighbor correction remains authoritative; its trainer now retains support diagnostics for future autonomous audits.
